# SMART 4K

> SMART 4K is a premium IPTV streaming service providing access to 22,000+ live TV channels, 4K sports, and an extensive VOD library. Compatible with all major devices including Firestick, Android TV, Apple TV, Smart TVs, and iOS/Android phones.

## Service Highlights
- 22,000+ live channels in HD and 4K
- 100,000+ VOD titles (movies & series)
- Live sports: Premier League, NFL, NBA, UFC, LaLiga, Champions League
- Anti-freeze / buffer-free CDN technology
- 24/7 customer support via Telegram
- No contracts — monthly prepay only
- Instant activation after payment

## Plans & Pricing
- Monthly plan: from $14.99/month
- Quarterly and annual plans available
- Up to 4 simultaneous connections
- Free trial available
